findings.root: Recorded observation is presented as live session evidence

locations.source: <LayoutCard title={t('powershare.runtime.title', 'Live Session')}>
message={t('powershare.runtime.noData', 'No live Powershare session. Details appear when your vehicle starts sharing power.')}
aria-label={t('powershare.output.sectionLabel', 'Powershare output and live session')}

findings.mechanism: All five page DataStates explicitly use historical provenance (48-52). The observation hook supplies no age validation, active-session identity, or polling interval at these calls. RuntimeCard treats any old status/type/power/hours value as data, yet labels it Live Session; successful empty history is described as No live Powershare session. The accessible section label repeats the live assertion. Recorded data presence/absence does not establish a currently active/inactive physical session.
findings.sourceRepro: Read an otherwise successful response containing an old PowershareStateEnabled row and no recent observation: status is non-null, so RuntimeCard displays the old enabled label under Live Session. Alternatively return five successful empty arrays: the card asserts no live session without a live-state source. This is a source walkthrough, not an executed API/browser/test reproduction.
findings.fix: Use recorded-session/observation wording and preserve status, destination, output, hours and independent retry. Do not infer live activity from request success; obtain explicit freshness/session evidence before a live claim.
findings.dedup: Revalidated audit-page-087.json states issue at former RuntimeCard:37/43; one root, not separate title/empty/ARIA fixes. No existing derived Phase6 Powershare objective found.

findings.mechanism: TrendPoint retains ts, but both accessible chart data and exportData project only formatted clock label and value. buildSeries uses formatTime, not a full instant. Observations at the same clock time on different dates become indistinguishable after projection. The 48-row cap is not a bounded day/time-range guarantee.

findings.fix: Preserve full timestamp/offset as evidence identity in exported and accessible rows while retaining chronological ordering, numeric values, existing chart and shared date preferences.

findings.root: Known enum labels bypass localization and use mismatched prefixes
findings.mechanism: humanizeEnum strips the signal-name prefix or generic Powershare and CamelCase-splits raw text; it never receives t or selects localized known enum labels. Metadata declares PowershareState, PowershareTypeStatus and PowershareStopReasonStatus, not signal-name prefixes. Page and cards directly render its output in summary/session/stop/snapshot.
findings.sourceRepro: PowershareStateEnabled with prefix PowershareStatus follows generic stripping and yields State Enabled; PowershareTypeStatusHome with prefix PowershareType yields Status Home. Changing locale does not translate these known status labels. Unknown vendor enums must remain raw rather than inventing a translation. Source walkthrough only.
findings.fix: Map verified known enum identities to canonical localized labels using actual enum metadata; retain unknown raw values and existing inactive-before-active severity precedence. Catalog/source changes require separately assigned ownership.
findings.dedup: Revalidated audit-page-087.json architectureIssues helpers:71. Count one producer root rather than each consumer or each possible enum literal.

findings.root: Vehicle precondition has no loading/failure/authoritative-empty distinction
findings.mechanism: useSelectedVehicle internally uses useVehicles but returns only selection/list/record/setter, not query status. With no URL/store ID and vehicles undefined during initial load or initial error, selectedId is null and this page takes the same Select a vehicle branch as an authoritative empty fleet. No vehicle-source retry or failure distinction reaches the page.
findings.sourceRepro: Fresh workspace without persisted/query selection: let useVehicles be pending, then let its initial request fail without data. In both states effectiveId stays null and PowersharePage renders the identical noVehicle EmptyState; a failed fleet request cannot be retried from that surface. Source walkthrough only.
findings.fix: Distinguish vehicle lookup loading/failure/empty through the existing query/trust contract while retaining header-owned selection. Do not add a second device/workspace picker.
findings.dedup: Revalidated audit-page-087.json states issue former page:162; integration boundary, not reopening the accepted page migration.
